description: R.4.8 / R.5.1 cutover bridge — converts a to/from the JS core-engine model (the { documentId, body: { blocks: [...] } } shape that coreEngine.createCoreEditor consumes). The hosted component (TmDocumentCoreEngineHost) sends to JS and rebuilds the document from on save. R.5.1 — full round-trip (no data loss on save). Round-trips paragraphs, headings, lists, quotes, text runs + inline marks, paragraph alignment, AND the structural blocks that previously vanished: tables (rows/cells/spans/header + nested blocks, recursively), images (standalone ↔ a paragraph carrying a drawing run, plus inline ), and page breaks. Rich C# content the engine does not model (image source/asset/link/natural-size, token/field/note runs) is carried verbatim in a __docSource preserve channel and restored on the way back, with the engine-managed visible fields (text/url/size/wrap/position/caption/alt) overlaid on top so user edits survive.
